details.name: Kimi K3
details.meta: 2026.07 Release · Moonshot AI · 2.8T MoE Colossus · KDA Attention
details.desc: Moonshot AI's flagship 2.8-Trillion parameter model (104B active) released with open weights. Powered by novel Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), it drastically lowers KV cache memory while maintaining a pristine 1M token context window. Debuting with 1512 Elo on LMSYS Chatbot Arena, Kimi K3 rivals Western Tier-1 models in long-horizon reasoning and native multimodal comprehension.

details.name: GLM-5.3
details.meta: 2026.08 Release · Zhipu AI (Z.ai) · Agentic Environment Scaling Pioneer
details.desc: Zhipu AI's breakthrough 2026 flagship. Moving beyond raw parameter scaling, GLM-5.3 is the benchmark pioneer of 'Environment Scaling' post-training, learning through autonomous interaction across tens of thousands of sandboxes and bash environments. It ranks #1 globally on Terminal-Bench 3.0 and CyberGym vulnerability discovery, setting the gold standard for reliable autonomous agent execution.

details.name: DeepSeek-V4-Pro
details.meta: 2026.08 Release · Open Weights / 1.6T MoE · Industrial Open-Source Frontier
details.desc: DeepSeek's 1.6 Trillion parameter MoE (49B active) released with open weights. The 0813 revision achieved 80.6%-95.2% on SWE-bench Verified, delivering parity with top-tier proprietary models at unprecedented cost efficiency.

details.name: Claude Fable 5.1
details.meta: 2026.09 Release · Anthropic Proprietary · Autonomous Agentic Pioneer
details.desc: Anthropic's September 2026 flagship, leading both Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (66) and LMSYS Arena (1520 Elo). Pioneering advanced autonomous agentic planning, multi-file code refactoring, and self-correction protocols.

details.name: GPT-6 Astra
details.meta: 2026.09 Release · OpenAI Proprietary · Long-Horizon Autonomous Reasoning
details.desc: OpenAI's breakthrough Autumn 2026 flagship model. Dominates Olympiad-level mathematics and multi-agent game-theoretic planning, featuring full self-directed execution with robust safety and alignment guardrails.

details.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
details.desc: Google's ultra-low latency model engineered for interactive and agentic microservices. Features 240+ t/s throughput and sub-120ms time-to-first-token across a native 2-million token multimodal context window.

about.heroDesc: LLM Infrastructure, High-Throughput Serving & Autonomous Agent Systems Engineer
about.p1: This is my technical dossier documenting deep-dives into LLM foundation architectures, distributed serving post-mortems, and production agentic runtimes. Graduated with a B.S. in Computer Science from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (BUPT), focusing on trillion-parameter inference serving, KV Cache memory topology modeling, and production-grade autonomous agent loops.
about.authorAffiliation: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (BUPT) · Computer Science
about.authorMotto: Code must be verifiable, data must have provenance, and topology must be backed by mathematics. Moving beyond shallow prompts into rock-solid AI systems engineering.
about.creed1Desc: No blind guessing. Deep dive into physical KV Cache page virtualization, low-rank latent compression, and GPU communication topologies to mathematically quantify memory footprints and bandwidth saturation.
about.creed2Desc: No toy demos. All insights stem from hands-on debugging on 4-node 32-GPU H100 bare-metal clusters, troubleshooting mixed parallel (TP/PP/EP) deadlocks, Triton kernel exceptions, and memory fragmentation.
about.creed3Desc: Moving beyond pure text conversations to embrace the 2026 Environment Scaling paradigm: Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool buses, MCTS reflection self-correction, and zero-escape Linux container sandboxes.
about.pillar1Detail: vLLM / SGLang production serving, PagedAttention memory virtualization, Chunked Prefill, FP8 dynamic quantization, and high-concurrency API gateways.
about.pillar2Detail: DeepSeek MLA (Multi-head Latent Attention) low-rank projection mathematics, Kimi Delta Attention state progressions, and RoPE long-context extrapolation.
about.pillar3Detail: Model Context Protocol (MCP) unified bus, Agent Runloops, MCTS-based self-reflection, and secure sandboxed Docker/eBPF runtimes.
about.pillar4Detail: SWE-bench Verified real-world code repairs, Terminal-Bench 3.0 sandboxed execution, LMSYS Arena evals, and price-to-performance frontier analysis.
about.eduSchool: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (BUPT)
about.eduDesc: Specialized in computer architecture, operating systems, distributed computing, and deep learning, building the rigorous engineering foundation required for low-level systems work.
about.clusterDesc: Hands-on experience tuning 4-node 32x H100 bare-metal clusters, 8x A100/H800 nodes, and RTX 4090 clusters across InfiniBand RoCE topologies and multi-GPU parallel pipelines.
